answer: Random beacon checks and a compute heartbeat stop bulk sybils. Each agent locks 60 coins and a jade seal to join. The beacon fires at random, and every agent must answer with a heartbeat within 10 minutes; two misses slash the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 coins against a 30,000-coin monthly pool, plus 1,000 machines on heartbeat duty — a dune no attacker climbs to the summit. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
